correctness.rationale: For all forms of sl2 in odd characteristic, the Killing-normalized bilinear form is nondegenerate. Direct calculation of the alternating torsion on the three standard basis pairs proves T_N(x,y)=b(v,v)b(u,[x,y])u for each rank-one tensor N=b(v,·)u; injective scalar extension proves it for every form. Perfectness and nondegeneracy make b(v,v)=0 necessary and sufficient. A smooth conic of isotropic projective covectors gives the exact projective locus. The finite-field cone has q^2-1 nonzero points; (q^3-1)(q^2-1)/(q-1) gives the count, and fixing b(u,v)=t yields the trace breakdown. Package verify.py exhaustively checks q=3,5,7 and the torsion expansion. Limits: no conclusion for char2 or higher rank.

value.rationale: The rank-one locus is a geometrically natural boundary stratum of the Nijenhuis equation, distinct from well-studied regular semisimple operators. Its complete reduced projective identification with P^2 times a smooth Killing conic provides a field-sensitive obstruction (anisotropic forms have none), while the uniform finite-field count and trace/square-zero refinement identify concrete arithmetic invariants. This is structurally motivated, not a selected arbitrary small example.
